title: Sign-in, demo accounts and role landing pages
story: The portal has no role picker. A person types an email and a password, and the server decides from the account which portal to open: the back-office workspace (staff, administrator and the two coordinators), the Dean Portal, the Faculty Portal or the Student Portal. This case shows that typed sign-in, the demo-only Demo accounts panel, and the page each role lands on.

The Demo accounts panel is shown only when the server says so: demonstration mode must be on (DEMO_MODE) and DEMO_SHOW_ACCOUNTS must not be set to 0. On a local copy it is shown. On a public site it is hidden, and the sign-in page is only the two-field form; then the presenter types the email and password. Every demo account uses the same password, DemoPass123!. The buttons that reset a demo case are explained in {case:reset-demo}.

parts.title: Part A - A real typed sign-in

steps.text: Open the portal address in a new browser window. The page reads **Graduate School Lifecycle Portal**, with the **Sign in** card on the right and the **Email** and **Password** fields empty; nothing is pre-filled. On a local copy the **Demo accounts** panel (marked **Demo mode**) sits under the heading, collapsed. It appears only when the server reports that demo accounts may be listed; on a public site it is not there.

shots.caption: The sign-in page: empty Email and Password fields and the collapsed Demo accounts panel marked Demo mode.

steps.text: Type the email staff@usls.edu.ph and a wrong password, then select **Sign in**. The page stays on the sign-in screen and a red message under the button reads **Incorrect email or password.** What was typed stays in the fields, so it can be corrected. The server refuses the attempt, not the page.

shots.caption: A wrong password is refused with the message Incorrect email or password.

steps.text: Clear both fields and type staff@usls.edu.ph in **Email** and DemoPass123! in **Password**. The password is masked while you type; the eye button (Show password) reveals it.

shots.caption: Credentials typed into the empty form.

steps.text: Select **Sign in**. The staff workspace opens on the **Dashboard**. The top bar shows the breadcrumb Graduate School Staff Portal > Dashboard and the chip Grace Fernandez · Graduate School Staff. The left sidebar has five groups: **Overview**, **Records**, **Lifecycle Workflows** (numbered 1 to 9), **Standalone Processes** and **Monitoring & support**.

shots.caption: The staff landing page: the Dashboard with the role-specific sidebar.

steps.text: Select the bell icon in the top bar. The **Notifications** panel opens with a **Mark all read** link and the notices addressed to this account, such as a request that is waiting for staff. Close it with Escape.

shots.caption: The notification bell open on the staff Dashboard.

steps.text: Select the sign-out icon (door with an arrow, named Sign out) at the right of the top bar. The portal returns to the sign-in page and the session is closed.

shots.caption: After sign-out, the sign-in page is shown again.

parts.title: Part B - The Demo accounts panel
parts.intro: This panel is shown only when the server runs in demonstration mode and DEMO_SHOW_ACCOUNTS is not 0 (the sign-in page asks the server and hides the panel otherwise). It lists every ready-made account so a presenter does not have to remember emails. Nothing is filled in until a button is chosen.

steps.text: Select **Demo accounts** to expand it. The first list, **Staff, Dean, Faculty and Student**, shows the shared password **DemoPass123!** and seven accounts (GS Staff, Academic Coordinator, Research Coordinator, Administrator, Dean, Faculty, Student), each with **Fill form** and **Sign in** buttons. Below it, **Student workflow demos** lists the groups in lifecycle order: **1 · Student Handoff**, **2 · Course Adjustments**, **3 · Enrollment**, **5–7 · Research, Panel & Defense**, **8 · Practicum**, **9 · Graduation**. Then come **Standalone processes**: **Leave of Absence**, **Readmission**, **AWOL & Residency** and **Withdrawal**. Each group shows how many students it holds; only one group is open at a time.

shots.caption: The expanded Demo accounts panel: the role accounts and the workflow demo student groups.

steps.text: **Fill form** copies an account into the two sign-in fields and shows the password, so the normal **Sign in** button can be used. The **Sign in** button inside the panel signs in at once. Selecting a student's name inside an open group signs in as that student. These are demonstration shortcuts; the typed sign-in in Part A is the same sign-in.

Open the group **1 · Student Handoff** and select the red **Reset** button beside Anton Bautista. The browser asks for confirmation (Reset Anton Bautista's Student-Handoff demo? ...); confirm it. A green notice at the bottom of the panel says the demo was reset and the student is ready to begin again. The panel signs in as a staff account for a moment to do this and signs out again, because the server only resets for Graduate School staff.

shots.caption: Anton Bautista reset: the green notice confirms the Student-Handoff demo data was cleared.

steps.text: Use a reset before any demonstration case that changes a student, so the case starts from a known state; it clears only that student's submissions, messages, tasks and staff actions for that workflow. When the panel is hidden (public site) the resets are done from the staff workflow pages instead; that button is shown in {case:reset-demo}.

parts.title: Part C - Where each role lands
parts.intro: Each account below is signed in by typing its email and DemoPass123! into the empty form. The server, not the form, decides the portal.

steps.text: Sign in as **academic@usls.edu.ph**. The **Academic Coordinator Portal** opens on the **Dashboard** (Welcome, Ramon). The sidebar is shortened: **Overview** has Dashboard and Reports & Analytics (no Academic Semesters); **Records** has Students, Faculty, Monitoring Sheet and Enrollment Class List; **Lifecycle Workflows** shows 2 · Course Adjustments, 3 · Enrollment, 4 · Course Audit, 5 · Research Gate, 6 · Panel Matching, 8 · Practicum and 9 · Graduation Endorsement (no 1 · Student Handoff and no 7 · Defense Scheduling); **Standalone Processes** has only AWOL & Residency; and **Monitoring & support** has Work Queue, Policy Assistant and Business Rules. There is no Leave of Absence, Readmission, Subject Withdrawal, Activity Log or Policy Documents entry.

shots.caption: Academic Coordinator (Dr. Ramon Alvarez): the Dashboard and the shortened sidebar.

steps.text: Sign in as **research@usls.edu.ph**. The **Research Coordinator Portal** opens on the **Dashboard** (Welcome, Sofia). The sidebar is limited to Dashboard; Monitoring Sheet; **Lifecycle Workflows** 5 · Research Gate, 6 · Panel Matching, 7 · Defense Scheduling and 9 · Graduation Endorsement; and Work Queue, Policy Assistant and Business Rules.

shots.caption: Research Coordinator (Dr. Sofia Mendoza): the Dashboard and the research-only sidebar.

steps.text: Sign in as **admin@usls.edu.ph**. The **Administrator Portal** opens on the Dashboard with the full staff sidebar (the same entries as the staff account). The top bar reads System Administrator · Administrator.

shots.caption: Administrator: the same full workspace as staff, for review.

steps.text: Sign in as **dean@usls.edu.ph**. The **Dean Portal** opens on the **Dashboard** (Welcome, Manuel; the button **Open approvals queue**). The sidebar has **Overview** (Dashboard), **Approvals** (Approvals Queue, Course Adjustments, Leave of Absence, Readmission, AWOL & Residency, Subject Withdrawal, Practicum Reports, Graduation Endorsement, Admission & Coursework Reports, each with a count of what is waiting) and **Monitoring & Support** (Reports & Analytics, Activity Log, Policy Assistant, Business Rules).

shots.caption: Dean (Dr. Manuel Villaruz): the Dean Portal Dashboard and approvals navigation.

steps.text: Sign in as **liwayway.bautista@usls.edu.ph**. The **Faculty Portal** opens on the **Dashboard** (Welcome, Liwayway). The sidebar has **Advising & Research** (My Advisees, Signatures & Endorsements, Panel Assignments & Papers, Panel Invitations, Defense Schedule, My Calendar, My Availability, Verdicts), **Teaching** (Assigned Classes) and **Support** (Policy Assistant, Business Rules). The footer says a faculty member sees only the advisees and panels assigned to them.

shots.caption: Faculty (Dr. Liwayway Bautista): the Faculty Portal Dashboard.

steps.text: Sign in as **student@usls.edu.ph**. The **Student Portal** opens on the **Dashboard** (Welcome, Miguel) with the student's course of study, student number and lifecycle position. The sidebar groups are **Overview**, **Academics**, **Research**, **Requests** and **Support**.

shots.caption: Student (Miguel Yu): the Student Portal Dashboard.

notes: There is no Registrar login. The Registrar is an external office; the platform only exports and imports files for it.

Staff, Academic Coordinator, Research Coordinator and Administrator share the back-office workspace; the sidebar is trimmed to what each role may open. The Dean, Faculty and Student accounts have their own portals.
The Demo accounts panel and the reset buttons exist only in demonstration mode and are hidden on a public site (DEMO_SHOW_ACCOUNTS=0). The shared password is a demonstration value.
After a refused sign-in the typed values stay in the fields and the red message stays on screen under the Sign in button.
